name: Ōe no Masafusa
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 73); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1112.

poems.title: The cherry trees are blossoming
poems.author: Ōe no Masafusa
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 73
poems.text:
The cherry trees are blossoming
On Takasago’s height;
Oh may no mountain mist arise,
No clouds so soft and white,
To hide them from our sight.
